verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Our Father, who art in Heaven,
hallowed be thy name;

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Thy kingdom come,
Thy will be done
on earth as it is in Heaven.

verse.name: v1c
v1d
verse.lines:
and lead us not into temptation,
but deliver us from evil.

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
For the kingdom,
the power and the glory are Yours
now, and forever.
